query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Build a cross-channel marketing and operations report by pulling Meta Ads performance and account status, GA4 funnel and revenue data, Instagram profile/insights, Microsoft Clarity friction metrics, and ClickUp docs/tasks for planning context.
query_ground_truth.query: pull meta ads performance metrics and account status
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve campaign performance data and current account status from Meta Ads.

request.query: pull meta ads performance metrics and account status

results.use_case: pull meta ads performance metrics and account status
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if auth/identity context is uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the connected identity using METAADS_GET_USER (sanity-check session before large reads).
[Required (if reporting account is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: List accessible accounts using METAADS_GET_AD_ACCOUNTS (follow paging cursors until exhausted, then select the reporting account).

[Optional (if direct listing is empty or reporting is business/client-scoped)] [Prerequisite]: Find the right account using METAADS_LIST_BUSINESS_AD_ACCOUNTS or METAADS_LIST_CLIENT_AD_ACCOUNTS (use the returned ad-account identifier).
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve campaign-level performance using METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS (request core delivery/cost plus actions/action_values/cost_per_action_type for the chosen window).

[Required (if paging.next or paging cursors present)] [Step]: Paginate METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS (iterate cursors/next; aggregate and de-duplicate by campaign identifier and any breakdown keys; optionally use COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH if payloads are too large).

[Optional (if names/status are needed or deeper drivers must be isolated)] [Next Step]: Enrich or drill down using METAADS_GET_OBJECT and/or METAADS_READ_ADSETS or METAADS_LIST_ADS (then re-run METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS at a lower level and join back).

[Fallback (if auth/throttle/validation/empty results block reporting)] [Fallback]: Retry METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS with smaller windows/fewer fields and backoff; if still failing, re-select the reporting account via METAADS_GET_AD_ACCOUNTS (and if needed METAADS_LIST_BUSINESS_AD_ACCOUNTS or METAADS_LIST_CLIENT_AD_ACCOUNTS) after re-auth resolves access.
known_pitfalls: [METAADS_GET_AD_ACCOUNTS] Responses may be nested (e.g., data.data) and still include paging cursors; missing pagination can hide additional accounts or return an incomplete list.

[METAADS_GET_AD_ACCOUNTS] Auth/session or permission issues can surface as OAuthException code=190 (including subcodes like 463/467), HTTP 401, or HTTP 403; reporting is blocked until access is corrected.
[METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS] Throttling may surface as OAuthException code=4 with error_subcode=1504022; reduce fields/window and apply exponential backoff.
[METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS] Window/preset validation can fail (e.g., OAuthException code=100, unsupported preset, start>end); treat empty data as a valid outcome and sanity-check with an alternate window.

[METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS] Many metrics arrive as strings; actions/action_values/cost_per_action_type are sparse arrays keyed by action_type (sometimes with attribution keys), so parse defensively to avoid double-counting.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Create, edit and get insights from ads across Meta technologies, including Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and more.

METAADS_GET_AD_ACCOUNTS.description: Tool to retrieve all ad account IDs accessible to the authenticated user from Meta Ads. Use when you need to get a user's ad account information including account IDs, names, and other account details.

limit.description: Maximum number of ad accounts to return (default 25)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Common fields: id, name, account_id, currency, timezone_name, account_status, business_name, business. The 'id' field returns the ad account ID prefixed with 'act_', while 'account_id' returns the numeric ID without prefix.

METAADS_GET_INSIGHTS.description: Get insights data for a Meta Ads object (ad account, campaign, ad set, or ad) using the Meta Marketing API. Supports various metrics, breakdowns, and filtering options with flexible date ranges. Results are paginated; follow `paging.cursors.after` or `paging.next` to retrieve all rows. Missing metric values in results should not be assumed to be zero.

sort.description: Fields to sort by with direction (_ascending or _descending suffix)

after.description: Cursor for the next page of results, usually taken from paging.cursors.after in the previous response.

level.description: Level at which to aggregate the data Must match the type of object referenced by `object_id` (e.g., 'account' for 'act_...' IDs, 'campaign' for campaign IDs, 'adset' for ad set IDs, 'ad' for ad IDs); mismatches return empty or misleading metrics. Allowed values: 'account', 'campaign', 'adset', 'ad'.

limit.description: Maximum number of insight rows to return for this page. Use paging.cursors.after or paging.cursors.before from the response to request another page.

before.description: Cursor for the previous page of results, usually taken from paging.cursors.before in the previous response.

fields.description: List of metric fields to include in the response. Valid standalone fields include: impressions, clicks, spend, reach, cpc, cpm, ctr, frequency, account_name, account_id, campaign_name, campaign_id, adset_name, adset_id, ad_name, ad_id, objective, buying_type, date_start, date_stop. For conversion/action metrics: 'actions' (returns all action types with counts), 'action_values' (returns monetary values for all actions), 'conversions' (returns conversion-specific actions), 'conversion_values' (returns monetary values for conversions). Breakdown dimensions such as publisher_platform, platform_position, impression_device, age, gender, and country should be supplied through breakdowns; if included here they are moved automatically. Do NOT use 'conversion_value' (singular) as it is not a valid field - use 'action_values' or 'conversion_values' instead.

filtering.description: Filters to apply to the data

object_id.description: ID of the object to get insights for (ad account, campaign, ad set, or ad). For ad accounts, the ID must include the act_ prefix (e.g., act_123456789). Campaign, ad set, and ad IDs are numeric only.

breakdowns.description: List of breakdown dimensions to apply to the data, such as publisher_platform, platform_position, impression_device, age, gender, country, region, or device_platform.

since.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be within the last 37 months from the current date (Meta API limitation).

time_range.description: Custom date range for the insights. If provided, date_preset should be set to null/None to use this custom range instead. Must be a dict with keys `since` and `until` in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., {'since': '2024-01-01', 'until': '2024-01-31'}). Never provide both time_range and date_preset simultaneously.

date_preset.description: Predefined date range for the insights. Defaults to 'last_30d' if neither date_preset nor time_range is specified. Allowed values: 'today', 'yesterday', 'last_7d', 'last_30d', 'this_month', 'last_month', 'this_quarter'. Case-insensitive (e.g., 'LAST_30D' is normalized to 'last_30d'). Set to null/None only if you provide a custom time_range.

date_range_defaulted.description: Internal field to track if date_preset was defaulted. Do not set this manually.

field_transformations.description: Internal field to track any field transformations made. Do not set this manually.

breakdown_transformations.description: Internal field to track breakdown fields moved out of fields. Do not set this manually.

action_attribution_windows.description: Attribution windows for conversion metrics. Defaults to `[7d_click]` to match Meta's unified attribution default; add `VIEW_1D`/`CLICK_28D`/etc. explicitly if you need legacy multi-window behavior. Different window values yield significantly different conversion counts; use consistent windows when comparing across campaigns or time periods.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Common fields: id, name, account_id, account_status, currency, timezone_name, business_name, business. The 'id' field returns the ad account ID prefixed with 'act_', while 'account_id' returns the numeric ID without prefix.

business_id.description: The ID of the business to retrieve owned ad accounts for
